_help: MCP servers FATMEE connects to at startup. ${NAME} is replaced with that value from backend/.env. A server whose required_env is missing is skipped (FATMEE still starts). 'expose' lists tool names (or parts of names) the planner may call directly; 'approval' lists tools that must wait for the user's OK; 'max_per_task' limits how often a tool runs per question; 'timeout' (seconds) gives a server's tools more time than FATMEE_MCP_TIMEOUT. For servers FATMEE starts itself (stdio): "command": "python" is FATMEE's own Python, relative paths start from this folder, and only the settings in 'pass_env' are given to the server process.

tavily.description: Web search and page reading by Tavily (remote, nothing installed locally).

linkedin.description: FATMEE's own LinkedIn MCP server (official LinkedIn API, OAuth 2.0). Log in once at /linkedin/connect.
